body: I've retested with gt 1.1.0, which is the same commit as main (44915d2), and updated the description with its output. Both problems remain: `gt run view`, `gt run jobs` and `gt run logs` fail on the bare-array job listing, and run URLs from `gt pr checks` resolve to the wrong run. I also added the version message from `gt project workflow list`, which calls Forgejo 17.0.1 "Gitea 17.0.1".
